summary: Tested SOW Delivery Table UI fixes. All requested features verified: 1) Collapsible stats (Hide/Show Stats button), 2) DD MM YYYY date format, 3) Consistent StatusBadge for both scope and deliverable rows, 4) Expand All/Collapse All buttons, 5) Export CSV button, 6) Add Scope dialog, 7) View scope modal, 8) Reopen buttons on implemented deliverables (3 found), 9) Locked badge on implemented scopes, 10) Backend validation for Implemented/WIP without Start Date.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SOW Delivery Table UI fixes verified. All features working correctly.
